title: Laravel Suspicious Login: Detect and Block Risky Logins
content:
Spatie's Laravel Suspicious Login scores each login by device, IP address, and country, then emails the user or blocks the login based on the risk.

The post Laravel Suspicious Login: Detect and Block Risky Logins appeared first on Laravel News.
